corrections.reason: The printed Ge'ez subjunctive form is clearly ኢንብላዕ (matching lines 8 and 20), where 6th-order ብ and 4th-order ላ were misread as በል.
The printed Amharic gerundive compound is መክረውብሃል (with 6th-order ክ, 'they have plotted against you'), misread as 1st-order ከ.
The printed Ge'ez word is አድገኒ (accusative አድገ + enclitic -ኒ, 'a mount also'), where 1st-order ገ was misread as 6th-order ግ.
Stage 1 hallucinated spurious አ characters before the word dividers; the printed Ge'ez text clearly reads ለዝ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ አኀዝዎ ፡ አይሁድ ፡.
Stage 1 hallucinated spurious አ characters before the punctuation; the printed Ge'ez text clearly reads ወፈቀዱ ፡ ይቅትልዎ ።.
